from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import datetime

from rich.console import Console
from rich.panel import Panel
from rich.table import Table


UNITS_LABEL = {
    "metric": ("C", "m/s"),
    "imperial": ("F", "mph"),
    "standard": ("K", "m/s"),
}


def render_weather(data: dict, units: str = "metric") -> None:
    console = Console()

    city = data["name"]
    country = data["sys"]["country"]
    weather = data["weather"][0]
    main = data["main"]
    wind = data["wind"]

    temp_unit, speed_unit = UNITS_LABEL.get(units, ("K", "m/s"))

    table = Table(show_header=False, box=None, padding=(0, 2))
    table.add_column("label", style="bold cyan")
    table.add_column("value")

    table.add_row("Condition", f"{weather['description'].capitalize()}")
    table.add_row("Temperature", f"{main['temp']}°{temp_unit}")
    table.add_row("Feels Like", f"{main['feels_like']}°{temp_unit}")
    table.add_row("Humidity", f"{main['humidity']}%")
    table.add_row("Wind", f"{wind['speed']} {speed_unit}")

    panel = Panel(
        table,
        title=f"[bold]{city}, {country}[/bold]",
        subtitle=f"[dim]{weather['main']}[/dim]",
        expand=False,
    )
    console.print(panel)


def render_forecast(data: dict, units: str = "metric", days: int = 5) -> None:
    console = Console()

    city = data["city"]["name"]
    country = data["city"]["country"]
    temp_unit, speed_unit = UNITS_LABEL.get(units, ("K", "m/s"))

    by_day: dict[str, list[dict]] = defaultdict(list)
    for entry in data["list"]:
        date_str = entry["dt_txt"].split(" ")[0]
        by_day[date_str].append(entry)

    table = Table(title=f"[bold]{city}, {country}[/bold] — {days}-Day Forecast")
    table.add_column("Date", style="bold cyan")
    table.add_column("Condition")
    table.add_column(f"Low (°{temp_unit})", justify="right")
    table.add_column(f"High (°{temp_unit})", justify="right")
    table.add_column("Humidity", justify="right")
    table.add_column(f"Wind ({speed_unit})", justify="right")

    for i, (date_str, entries) in enumerate(sorted(by_day.items())):
        if i >= days:
            break

        temps = [e["main"]["temp"] for e in entries]
        humidities = [e["main"]["humidity"] for e in entries]
        winds = [e["wind"]["speed"] for e in entries]
        conditions = [e["weather"][0]["description"] for e in entries]
        # Pick the most common condition for the day
        condition = max(set(conditions), key=conditions.count).capitalize()

        date_label = datetime.strptime(date_str, "%Y-%m-%d").strftime("%a %b %d")

        table.add_row(
            date_label,
            condition,
            f"{min(temps):.1f}",
            f"{max(temps):.1f}",
            f"{round(sum(humidities) / len(humidities))}%",
            f"{max(winds):.1f}",
        )

    console.print(table)

def render_weather(data: dict, units: str = "metric", verbose: bool = False) -> None:
    console = Console()

    city = data["name"]
    country = data["sys"]["country"]
    weather = data["weather"][0]
    main = data["main"]
    wind = data["wind"]

    temp_unit, speed_unit = UNITS_LABEL.get(units, ("K", "m/s"))

    table = Table(show_header=False, box=None, padding=(0, 2))
    table.add_column("label", style="bold cyan")
    table.add_column("value")

    table.add_row("Condition", f"{weather['description'].capitalize()}")
    table.add_row("Temperature", f"{main['temp']}°{temp_unit}")
    table.add_row("Feels Like", f"{main['feels_like']}°{temp_unit}")
    table.add_row("Humidity", f"{main['humidity']}%")
    table.add_row("Wind", f"{wind['speed']} {speed_unit}")

    if verbose:
        if "pressure" in main:
            table.add_row("Pressure", f"{main['pressure']} hPa")
        if "visibility" in data:
            vis_km = data["visibility"] / 1000
            table.add_row("Visibility", f"{vis_km:.1f} km")

            table.add_row("Sunset", sunset)

        table,
        title=f"[bold]{city}, {country}[/bold]",
        subtitle=f"[dim]{weather['main']}[/dim]",
        expand=False,

    panel = Panel(
        table,
        title=f"[bold]{city}, {country}[/bold]",
        subtitle=f"[dim]{weather['main']}[/dim]",
        expand=False,
    )
    console.print(panel)


def render_forecast(data: dict, units: str = "metric", days: int = 5) -> None:
    console = Console()

    city = data["city"]["name"]
    country = data["city"]["country"]
    temp_unit, speed_unit = UNITS_LABEL.get(units, ("K", "m/s"))

    by_day: dict[str, list[dict]] = defaultdict(list)
    for entry in data["list"]:
        date_str = entry["dt_txt"].split(" ")[0]
        by_day[date_str].append(entry)

    table = Table(title=f"[bold]{city}, {country}[/bold] — {days}-Day Forecast")
    table.add_column("Date", style="bold cyan")
    table.add_column("Condition")
    table.add_column(f"Low (°{temp_unit})", justify="right")
    table.add_column(f"High (°{temp_unit})", justify="right")
    table.add_column("Humidity", justify="right")
    table.add_column(f"Wind ({speed_unit})", justify="right")

    for i, (date_str, entries) in enumerate(sorted(by_day.items())):
        if i >= days:
            break

        temps = [e["main"]["temp"] for e in entries]
        humidities = [e["main"]["humidity"] for e in entries]
        winds = [e["wind"]["speed"] for e in entries]
        conditions = [e["weather"][0]["description"] for e in entries]
        # Pick the most common condition for the day
        condition = max(set(conditions), key=conditions.count).capitalize()

        date_label = datetime.strptime(date_str, "%Y-%m-%d").strftime("%a %b %d")

        table.add_row(
            date_label,
            condition,
            f"{min(temps):.1f}",
            f"{max(temps):.1f}",
            f"{round(sum(humidities) / len(humidities))}%",
            f"{max(winds):.1f}",
        )

    console.print(table)

from weather_cli.display import render_forecast, render_weather

SAMPLE_DATA = {
    "name": "Tokyo",

    "weather": [{"main": "Clear", "description": "clear sky"}],
    "main": {"temp": 28.0, "feels_like": 30.0, "humidity": 65},
    "wind": {"speed": 5.1},
}

SAMPLE_FORECAST_DATA = {
    "city": {"name": "Tokyo", "country": "JP"},

            "dt_txt": "2025-01-15 06:00:00",

            "weather": [{"main": "Clouds", "description": "scattered clouds"}],
            "wind": {"speed": 4.0},
        },
    ],
}


def test_render_weather_contains_city(capsys):
    render_weather(SAMPLE_DATA, units="metric")
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert "Tokyo" in captured.out
    assert "JP" in captured.out

    render_weather(SAMPLE_DATA, units="metric")
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert "28.0" in captured.out
    assert "°C" in captured.out

    assert "mph" in captured.out

    assert "Jan 16" in captured.out

    render_forecast(SAMPLE_FORECAST_DATA, units="metric", days=1)
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert "Jan 15" in captured.out
    assert "Jan 16" not in captured.out

    render_forecast(SAMPLE_FORECAST_DATA, units="metric")
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    # Jan 15 has temps 5.0 and 10.0 — low should be 5.0, high 10.0
    assert "5.0" in captured.out
    assert "10.0" in captured.out
